detail.abstract: This paper analyses the extensive and intensive margins of demand for a retail digital euro. We conducted a representative survey in France, Germany and Italy in November-December 2023. We find that 52-62% of respondents are willing to hold a digital euro, depending on the interest rate spread, with a higher share in Italy than in France or Germany. Design features (cash-like vs deposit-like) appear to play only a very limited role. Average demand depends on the hypothetical interest rate spread relative to current accounts and ranges from EUR 700 to EUR 1,100, implying an aggregate demand of 1.5-2.5% of GDP. Willingness to hold a digital euro is associated with socio-demographic factors, trust in the ECB and the EU, digitalisation and payment behaviour. Negative interest rate spreads relative to current accounts reduce willingness to hold the digital euro more strongly than positive spreads increase it. Behavioural characteristics tend to be correlated with the likelihood of adoption, whereas economic factors, particularly income and interest rates, are mainly related to the level of demand. This distinction becomes more pronounced when conditioning on positive demand, suggesting that socio-demographic factors primarily influence participation decisions rather than quantities demanded.

AI.tldr: 本文基于法、德、意三国代表性调查，研究了零售数字欧元的广延边际（是否愿意持有）和集约边际（持有数量），发现52-62%的受访者愿意持有，平均需求约700-1100欧元，占GDP的1.5-2.5%。行为特征主要影响是否采用，经济因素主要影响持有数量。
AI.research_question: 零售数字欧元的广延边际（是否愿意持有）和集约边际（愿意持有多少）分别受哪些因素影响？
AI.motivation: 欧洲央行正在探索发行零售数字欧元，但其潜在需求和消费者偏好尚不明确。了解公众的采用意愿和持有数量对设计数字欧元至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 广延边际（extensive margin）与集约边际（intensive margin）的区分；行为经济学因素（信任、数字化程度）与传统经济因素（收入、利率）对需求的差异化影响。
AI.method: 2023年11-12月在法国、德国、意大利进行代表性问卷调查，利用假设情境（hypothetical scenarios）测量不同利率差下的持有意愿和持有数量。
AI.findings: ①52-62%受访者愿意持有数字欧元，意大利高于法德；②设计特征（类现金vs类存款）影响有限；③平均需求700-1100欧元，总需求占GDP的1.5-2.5%；④负利率差对意愿的抑制强于正利率差的促进；⑤行为特征影响采用决策（广延边际），经济因素影响持有数量（集约边际）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将消费者需求分解为广延边际和集约边际，揭示了采用决策与数量决策的不同决定因素，丰富了数字央行货币（CBDC）需求理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧洲央行设计数字欧元（利率设置、功能设计）提供实证依据；表明应关注利率差对需求的不对称影响，以及不同国家间的异质性。

title: The Pattern-Causality Matrix for Directed Dependence in Nonlinear Time Series
affiliations: Monash University - Department of Econometrics & Business Statistics, University of Edinburgh Business School and Monash University - Department of Econometrics & Business Statistics

detail.title: The Pattern-Causality Matrix for Directed Dependence in Nonlinear Time Series
detail.abstract: The pattern-causality (PC) matrix shows how a directed relation between nonlinear time series is expressed locally. Most methods compress the relation into a single number; the PC matrix instead decomposes local responses into positive, negative, and mixed-pattern (dark) classes, laid out as a heatmap that can be read, summarized numerically, and computed for all ordered pairs in a multivariate system. We build the matrix from delay embedding, nearest-neighbor projection following Farmer & Sidorowich (1987), and a signature-to-pattern map, and we equip it with a timeseries-aware assessment layer: block-based stability summaries, a null-calibrated detection rule, and a common-driver diagnostic that flags shared-driver-induced pairwise structure. Earlier work introduced pattern causality and showed empirical reach across finance, ecology, and neurology; here we make the matrix the object of study and give it a computational and statistical formulation. In controlled experiments it recovers designed structure, concentrating mass in the positive class under aligned dynamics and in the negative class under sign-reversing dynamics, with detection at the calibrated floor under an independent null. Applied to climate indices and residual stock returns, the matrix reveals local sign structure that scalar directed-dependence scores cannot reveal. The CRAN package patterncausality and reproducibility scripts regenerate every result.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并系统化了模式因果矩阵（PC矩阵），将非线性时间序列间的有向关系分解为正、负、混合三类局部模式，并配备时间序列感知的统计评估层，在模拟和实际数据中展示了超越传统标量方法的结构揭示能力。
AI.research_question: 如何将非线性时间序列间的有向因果关系从单一的标量度量扩展为包含局部模式信息的矩阵形式，并为其提供系统的计算与统计基础？
AI.motivation: 现有因果关系压缩方法（如单一数值）会丢失局部符号结构信息，无法区分正、负、混合三种因果模式；PC矩阵能保留这些信息，但此前缺乏系统的计算与统计框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 延迟嵌入（delay embedding）、近邻投影（Farmer & Sidorowich, 1987）、特征到模式的映射（signature-to-pattern map）；模式因果性（pattern causality）。
AI.method: 基于延迟嵌入和近邻投影构建PC矩阵，辅以块状稳定性摘要、零假设校准检测规则、共同驱动诊断器；通过模拟实验和真实数据（气候指数、股票残差收益）验证。
AI.findings: 模拟中正类在一致动力学下集中，负类在符号反转动力学下集中，独立零假设下检测到校准基线；实际应用中PC矩阵揭示了标量方法无法捕捉的局部符号结构。
AI.theory_contributions: 将模式因果性从经验工具提升为具有严谨计算和统计公式的理论对象；引入块稳定性、零校准检测、共同驱动诊断等新统计组件。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供R包patterncausality和可复现代码；为金融、生态、神经科学等领域提供更精细的因果模式分析工具。

title: Safety-Guided Deep Reinforcement Learning for Magnetic Microrobot Navigation and Precision Drug Delivery in Complex Vascular Networks
affiliations: Al Adan Hospital, American International University Kuwait and American International University Kuwait

detail.title: Safety-Guided Deep Reinforcement Learning for Magnetic Microrobot Navigation and Precision Drug Delivery in Complex Vascular Networks
detail.abstract: Magnetic microrobots are a promising approach for targeted drug delivery because they can be remotely guided toward localized therapeutic regions while reducing non-specific drug distribution. However, autonomous navigation in vascular environments remains difficult because of branching vessel structures, wall collision risks, misleading blood flow directions, target-location uncertainty, actuation disturbance, and restrictive vessel geometry. This study proposed a Safety-Guided Proximal Policy Optimization Deep Reinforcement Learning framework for magnetic microrobot navigation and target-zone drug delivery in simulated vascular networks. The proposed method combines a PPO-based navigation policy with a local magnetic safety-guidance layer that evaluates candidate actions, rejects unsafe movements, and selects vessel-aware, target-directed steering actions. A two-dimensional branching vascular environment was developed with randomized target placement, stochastic blood flow disturbance, collision constraints, misleading non-target branches, and automatic drug release upon entry into the target delivery radius. The framework was evaluated under progressively challenging scenarios, including standard conditions, moderate disturbance, high disturbance, and severe narrow vessel stress. The proposed method achieved 97.50% success under moderate disturbance, 87.50% success under high disturbance, and 69.17% success under severe narrow-vessel stress, showing realistic performance degradation as the environmental difficulty increased. Compared with the centerline, greedy direct, passive flow-following, and random baselines, the proposed framework maintained a stronger target-delivery performance and lower collision rates. These findings demonstrate that safety-guided reinforcement learning can improve the robustness of magnetic microrobot navigation in constrained vascular drug delivery simulations.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种安全引导的PPO深度强化学习框架，用于磁性微型机器人在模拟血管网络中的自主导航与靶向药物递送，在多种挑战性场景下实现了较高的成功率和较低的碰撞率。
AI.research_question: 如何实现磁性微型机器人在复杂血管环境中的自主导航与靶向药物递送？
AI.motivation: 磁性微型机器人在靶向药物递送中具有潜力，但血管环境存在分支结构、碰撞风险、血流干扰、目标位置不确定性、驱动扰动及几何限制等挑战，自主导航仍然困难。
AI.theoretical_framework: 安全引导的近端策略优化（PPO）深度强化学习框架，结合局部磁安全引导层进行动作评估与筛选。
AI.method: 构建二维分支血管环境，包含随机目标位置、随机血流扰动、碰撞约束、误导性非目标分支及自动药物释放机制；提出PPO导航策略与局部磁安全引导层相结合的框架，与中心线、贪婪直接、被动随流和随机四种基线方法进行对比。
AI.findings: 在标准、中等扰动、高扰动和严重窄血管应力场景下分别取得高成功率（中等扰动97.50%，高扰动87.50%，严重窄血管69.17%）；相比基线方法，本框架具有更强的靶向递送性能和更低的碰撞率。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了安全引导的深度强化学习能够提升磁性微型机器人在约束血管环境中的导航鲁棒性，为自主医疗机器人导航提供了新的方法论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为磁性微型机器人在复杂血管网络中的靶向药物递送提供了可行的自主导航方案，有望减少非特异性药物分布，提高治疗精准度。

title: Cognitive Morphology And Lexical Acquisition: Deconstructing The Etymological Paradigm In High-Stakes Administrative Examinations

detail.title: Cognitive Morphology And Lexical Acquisition: Deconstructing The Etymological Paradigm In High-Stakes Administrative Examinations
detail.abstract: For years, Indian competitive exams-especially the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) Civil Services Examination-have leaned almost entirely on rote memorization. This paper takes a hard look at a different linguistic method: learning through morphological parsing and etymological deduction. The central question here is: What really happens when students move from passively memorizing lists to actively breaking down word structure? The research explores how understanding a word's origins builds tough, lasting "cognitive maps" in the learner's memory. Concrete teaching tools like Prefix-Root-Suffix matrices and deduction from contextual clues show a clear drop in mental strain during high-pressure situations. The discussion also doesn't shy away from the limits of this method, like issues of words drifting in meaning or not being totally transparent. At the end, the paper puts forward an independent synthesis: true mastery of administrative language comes from weaving together the rigorous logic of etymology with real-world awareness of word pairings and context, creating a powerful vocabulary toolkit for future public administrators.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在印度公务员考试备考中，从死记硬背转向形态解析与词源推演的语言学习方法，发现该方法能构建持久的认知地图、降低高压下的心理负荷，并提出真正的语言掌握需要将词源逻辑与语境搭配相结合。
AI.research_question: 当学习者从被动记忆词汇列表转向主动拆解单词结构（形态解析与词源推演）时，究竟会发生什么？
AI.motivation: 印度竞争性考试（尤其是UPSC公务员考试）长期依赖死记硬背，但这种学习方式效果有限，需要探索更有效的语言学习方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 形态学解析（词根-前缀-后缀矩阵）、词源学推演、认知地图理论。
AI.method: 概念分析与教学工具论证，包括前缀-词根-后缀矩阵法和语境线索推演法。
AI.findings: 词源理解能帮助学习者构建持久的认知地图；具体教学工具能显著降低高压情境下的心理负荷；方法存在局限（词义漂移、透明度不足等问题）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出真正的语言掌握需要将词源逻辑与词搭配及语境意识相结合，形成综合性词汇习得框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度公务员考试备考提供了替代死记硬背的具体教学工具（如词根-前缀-后缀矩阵），有助于培养未来公共管理者的强大词汇工具包。

title: Diving into the Unknown Unknowns: Collective Action under Different Degrees of Uncertainty
affiliations: and Arizona State University (ASU)

detail.title: Diving into the Unknown Unknowns: Collective Action under Different Degrees of Uncertainty

declarations.funderStatement: This research was funded by a U.S. National Science Foundation grant (account GR 39387).

detail.abstract: Uncertainty plays a crucial role in economic decision-making and can be categorized into risk, ambiguity, and "unknown unknowns" based on the subject's level of knowledge. In an incentivized one-shot linear public goods game with 800 U.S. citizens, we introduce these types of uncertainty regarding the potential destruction of the public good in a between-subject design. Specifically, we split risk into two degrees as to capture more nuanced differences of uncertainty-namely simple and compound risk-and thus implement four treatment conditions. While participants in the condition RISK_SIMPLE know the exact probability of destruction, and those in RISK_COMPOUND know its discrete uniform distribution, participants in AMBIGUITY only learn about the destruction possibility, and those in UNKNOWN UNKNOWNS are only informed that an unspecified event may occur and that the setting is dangerous. Our results show that collective action efforts are significantly different when uncertainty takes on the type of unknown unknowns: we find higher levels of cooperation and more pronounced cooperative beliefs compared to the risky and ambiguous environments.

AI.tldr: 本文通过公共物品博弈实验，研究了风险、模糊和“未知的未知”三种不确定性对合作行为的影响，发现“未知的未知”条件下合作水平显著更高。
AI.research_question: 不同类型的知识不确定性（风险、模糊、未知的未知）如何影响公共物品博弈中的合作行为？
AI.motivation: 不确定性是经济决策的核心要素，但以往研究多关注风险和模糊，对“未知的未知”这类极端不确定性如何影响合作行为知之甚少。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不确定性分类理论（风险、模糊、未知的未知）；公共物品博弈理论；集体行动与合作决策理论。
AI.method: 激励性一次性线性公共物品博弈实验，800名美国公民被试，组间设计，设置四种处理条件：简单风险、复合风险、模糊、未知的未知。
AI.findings: 与风险和模糊条件相比，在“未知的未知”条件下被试表现出更高的合作水平和更强烈的合作信念；简单风险与复合风险之间无显著差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统比较了三种知识不确定性（特别是“未知的未知”）对合作行为的影响，丰富了不确定性决策与集体行动的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共政策制定、危机管理及组织设计等面临高度不确定情境下的合作促进策略提供了实证依据。

title: Balancing Development and Environmental Protection in India: The Role of Law, Policy, and the Judiciary

detail.title: Balancing Development and Environmental Protection in India: The Role of Law, Policy, and the Judiciary
detail.abstract: Environmental governance-the institutional arrangements for making decisions-across various sectors: water and air pollution, infrastructure projects, climate negotiations, and the associated environmental jurisprudence in India, formally institutionalised over the last four decades following the Stockholm Conference. Since then, it has increasingly confronted tensions between development-led growth and a rights-oriented judicial discourse. Narmada Bachao Andolan v. Union of India (2000) remains one of the first famous judicial engagements.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了印度过去四十年环境治理的制度化进程，探讨了发展导向的增长与权利导向的司法话语之间的张力，并以Narmada Bachao Andolan诉印度联邦案（2000年）作为司法介入环境治理的标志性案例。
AI.research_question: 印度环境治理制度化过程中，发展导向的经济增长与权利导向的司法话语之间存在怎样的张力？
AI.motivation: 环境治理在印度制度化已四十年，但在发展与权利之间的冲突日益凸显，需要系统梳理这一张力关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境治理制度化理论、发展与环境权司法话语的张力分析框架。
AI.method: 文献回顾与法律案例分析。
AI.findings: 印度环境治理制度化进程中，发展导向的决策与法院保护环境权的司法话语存在持续张力；Narmada Bachao Andolan案是这一张力的早期标志性司法实践。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了发展中国家环境治理制度化中发展权与环境权之间的内在矛盾，丰富了环境治理理论的国别经验。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度及其他发展中国家在环境治理中平衡发展与环境保护提供历史经验与政策启示。

title: Twice-Told Preferences: Reliability, Repeated Elicitation, and Household Wealth

detail.title: Twice-Told Preferences: Reliability, Repeated Elicitation, and Household Wealth
detail.abstract: Elicited preferences are measured noisily and usually only once, so their estimated links to behavior are attenuated. Using two Japanese household panels that re-ask an identical money-earlier-or-later question annually for fourteen years, I measure the attenuation and remove it. Wave-to-wave reliability is one-half while the persistent component decays by only two percent a year, so averaging a household’s answers, or instrumenting one wave with another, roughly doubles the discount-rate coeﬀicient. A one-standard-deviation increase in impatience predicts about 43% lower financial wealth and a 5.4-percentage-point lower probability of holding securities, twice the single-wave estimate. The gradient survives income, education, and financial-literacy controls, and the discarded variation looks like survey noise, not a moving required rate of return.

AI.tldr: 利用日本家庭面板数据（14年追踪），通过重复测量同一时间偏好问题，发现单次测量衰减严重（信度约0.5），通过平均多期回答或工具变量法，贴现率系数估计值翻倍。不耐烦程度每增加一个标准差，金融财富降低约43%，持有证券概率降低5.4个百分点，约为单次估计的两倍。
AI.research_question: elicited preferences（诱导偏好）的测量误差如何影响其与行为之间关联的估计？如何通过重复测量来纠正衰减偏差？
AI.motivation: elicited preferences通常只测量一次且存在噪声，这会导致其与行为间的估计关联被衰减（attenuated）。本文旨在量化这一衰减程度并予以纠正。
AI.theoretical_framework: 测量误差理论（attenuation bias）、时间偏好理论、面板数据计量方法（重复测量平均、工具变量法）
AI.method: 使用日本两个家庭面板数据集，连续14年重复询问相同的时间偏好问题（money-earlier-or-later）。通过波间信度（wave-to-wave reliability）和持久成分衰减率来评估测量质量，采用多波平均和工具变量法纠正衰减偏差。
AI.findings: （1）波间信度约为0.5，持久成分每年仅衰减2%；（2）平均多期回答或工具变量法使贴现率系数约翻倍；（3）不耐烦程度每增加一个标准差，金融财富降低约43%，持有证券概率降低5.4个百分点（约为单次估计的两倍）；（4）该梯度在控制收入、教育和金融素养后依然稳健；（5）被剔除的变异是调查噪声，而非随时间变化的必要回报率。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次利用长面板重复测量数据系统量化了elicited preferences的测量误差及其导致的衰减偏差，证实了测量误差是导致时间偏好与行为关联被低估的主要原因，而非理论上的随时间变化。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者提供了纠正时间偏好测量衰减偏差的方法（多波平均、工具变量）；为政策制定者和金融从业者更准确评估时间偏好对财务决策的影响提供了经验依据；揭示了单次调查测量时间偏好可能严重低估其对经济行为的影响。

title: Four Paths to Hilbert's Eighth Problem
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Four Paths to Hilbert's Eighth Problem
detail.abstract: We place the generalized gamma convolution (GGC) reformulation of the Riemann Hypothesis (RH) within the wider landscape of "real-zeros" programs-Pólya-de Bruijn-Newman, Lee-Yang/Cardon, Jensen polynomials, and van Dantzig-Wald-and, in light of recent work (Rodgers-Tao 2020; Konstantopoulos-Patie-Sarkar 2024), identify the most promising path. Three theses organise the paper. First, RH is a single positivity statement in four equivalent costumes: a Pick (Nevanlinna) condition, a complete-monotonicity (Thorin) condition, the de Bruijn-Newman value Λ dBN = 0, and van Dantzig membership of ξ in the Laguerre-Pólya class. Second, the algebraic operations native to the GGC and Wald frameworks-subordination, Esscher tilting, and Fourier/Möbius resummation-are provably incapable of supplying that positivity: they preserve or relabel it, never generate it. Third, the generative front is the Lee-Yang/Cardon construction, anchored by the unconditional von Mangoldt positivity that distinguishes ξ from Pólya's counterexample. We keep two tiers strictly separate throughout-an unconditional (subordinator) tier and an RH-equivalent (GGC) tier-and we make no claim to prove RH; the contribution is a map of the terrain and a program with explicit partial targets.

AI.tldr: 本文在广义伽马卷积（GGC）框架下重新表述黎曼假设（RH），将其置于多个“实零点”研究纲领（Pólya-de Bruijn-Newman、Lee-Yang/Cardon、Jensen多项式、van Dantzig-Wald）的广阔图景中，并结合近期工作，识别出最有希望的推进路径。文章提出三个核心论点：1）RH本质上是一个在四种等价形式中呈现的单一正性陈述；2）GGC和Wald框架的代数操作无法产生这种正性；3）生成性前沿在于Lee-Yang/Cardon构造。文章严格区分无条件层与RH等价层，不声称证明RH，而是提供一幅地形图及带有明确部分目标的行动计划。
AI.research_question: 如何将黎曼假设的GGC重新表述置于更广泛的实零点研究纲领中，并识别出最有希望的推进路径？
AI.motivation: 黎曼假设是数学中最著名的未解决问题之一。近年来，GGC重新表述提供了一个新视角，但需要将其与已有的多个研究纲领（Pólya-de Bruijn-Newman、Lee-Yang/Cardon、Jensen多项式、van Dantzig-Wald）联系起来，以厘清各框架间的关系，并基于最新进展（Rodgers-Tao 2020；Konstantopoulos-Patie-Sarkar 2024）确定最具潜力的研究方向。
AI.theoretical_framework: 广义伽马卷积（GGC）、Pólya-de Bruijn-Newman理论、Lee-Yang/Cardon构造、Jensen多项式、van Dantzig-Wald框架、Pick（Nevanlinna）条件、完全单调性（Thorin）条件、Laguerre-Pólya类、子ordination、Esscher倾斜、Fourier/Möbius重求和、von Mangoldt正性
AI.method: 理论分析与综合比较。论文不提出新的证明，而是通过系统梳理和比较多个等价的数学框架，分析各框架内代数操作的性质（保存/重新标记正性 vs. 生成正性），识别出能够真正产生所需正性的构造（Lee-Yang/Cardon），并严格区分无条件层与RH等价层。
AI.findings: 1）RH可以统一表述为四种等价形式的单一正性陈述：Pick条件、完全单调性条件、ΛdBN=0、ξ属于Laguerre-Pólya类的van Dantzig成员资格。2）GGC和Wald框架中的代数操作（子ordination、Esscher倾斜、Fourier/Möbius重求和）只能保存或重新标记正性，无法产生所需的正性。3）生成正性的前沿在于Lee-Yang/Cardon构造，其基础是使ξ区别于Pólya反例的无条件von Mangoldt正性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将GGC重新表述与多个经典实零点研究纲领进行系统性对接，揭示了它们之间的等价关系和深层结构。2）明确了各框架内代数操作的能力边界：保存正性而非生成正性。3）将生成性前沿定位在Lee-Yang/Cardon构造上，为后续RH研究提供了清晰的路线图。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为RH研究者提供了一份全面的地形图，明确指出了哪些路径已被证明是死胡同（GGC和Wald框架内的代数操作），以及哪些路径最有希望（Lee-Yang/Cardon构造）。2）设定了明确的部分目标和阶段性检验标准。3）严格区分无条件层与RH等价层的做法有助于避免混淆和错误推理。

title: When Waiting is Not a Price: Court-Processing Timing and Medical Utilization in Pretrial Detention
affiliations: UC Berkeley,  and UC Berkeley

detail.title: When Waiting is Not a Price: Court-Processing Timing and Medical Utilization in Pretrial Detention
detail.abstract: Waiting is often treated as a price or screen. We study a different form of administrative burden: delay generated by imperfect synchronization between courts and jails. Using Cook County jail records, we exploit weekend booking as quasi-experimental variation in detainees’ position relative to a weekday court-movement calendar. Among detainees held at least 60 days, an additional 24 hours before the first recorded court-related custody movement increases subsequent medical encounters by about 4 percent, with no detectable effects on incidents, infractions, or housing moves. Coordination burdens can shift costs across public institutions without revealing social need.

AI.tldr: 本文利用库克县监狱记录，以周末入狱作为准实验变量，研究法院与监狱之间因不同步导致的行政延误对在押人员的影响。结果表明，对于至少被拘留60天的在押人员，首次法庭相关羁押行动前每多延误24小时，后续医疗就诊次数增加约4%，而对违纪、事件或住房变动无显著影响。这种协调成本会转移公共机构间的成本，而不揭示社会需求。
AI.research_question: 法院与监狱之间因日程不同步导致的行政延误（等待时间）对在押人员后续医疗就诊、纪律事件等结果有何因果影响？
AI.motivation: 传统研究多将等待视为价格或筛选机制，但本文关注另一种行政负担形式——机构间协调不畅导致的延误。利用周末入狱这一准实验变异，探究司法系统内部不同步如何影响在押人员福利及公共机构间的成本转移。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行政负担理论、机构间协调成本理论、准实验设计
AI.method: 准实验方法：以周末入狱作为工具变量，利用法院工作日程与监狱日程的不匹配，比较不同入狱时间导致的首次法庭行动延误差异，进而估计其对医疗就诊等结果的影响。
AI.findings: 对于至少被拘留60天的在押人员，首次法庭行动前每多延误24小时，后续医疗就诊次数增加约4%；对纪律事件、暴力事件或住房变动无显著影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了行政负担中机构间协调成本这一被忽视的形式，证明等待不仅是个体层面的价格或筛选，更可能成为公共机构间成本转移的渠道，而不揭示真实的社会需求。
AI.practical_contributions: 为司法系统及监狱管理提供实证依据，提示优化法院与监狱间日程同步可减少在押人员不必要的医疗负担，同时降低公共机构的隐性成本，有助于更公平有效地分配资源。

title: Abstraction Contracts and Report-Level Non-Determinacy of Exploitability Claims

detail.title: Abstraction Contracts and Report-Level Non-Determinacy of Exploitability Claims
detail.abstract: Reports under game abstraction often provide a reported abstract object R = (G ′ , σ ′): an abstract game and an abstract behavior-strategy profile. Such a report is not itself an originalgame behavior profile. Consequently, an exploitability claim reported only as R is not checkable from what is reported: the lifting rule can change the original-game profile being evaluated. The remedy is direct: disclose the abstraction contract C = (G, G ′ , ϕ, λ, ρ, E), not only the abstract report. This note isolates the mechanism in a hand-checkable witness. The reported strategy assigns positive probability to two abstract actions, X and Y. Two contracts share the same G, G ′ , fixed many-to-one map ϕ, σ ′ , inert ρ, and evaluation E; their liftings λ 1 and λ 2 are both ϕ-compatible, so ϕ # (λ i (σ ′)) = σ ′. Nevertheless the induced original-game exploitability values are 2.0 and 4.0. The result is a minimal theorem/reproducibility note about report-level auditability.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一个最小化可验证案例证明，仅报告抽象博弈和抽象策略（抽象报告R）无法确保原始博弈中的可利用性（exploitability）可被复现和审计，必须同时披露完整的抽象合约（abstraction contract）才能实现可审计性。
AI.research_question: 在博弈抽象的报告框架下，仅报告抽象对象R（抽象博弈G'和抽象策略σ'）是否足以使原始博弈的可利用性声称可被审计和验证？
AI.motivation: 博弈抽象（game abstraction）常用于简化大规模博弈分析，但抽象报告中的可利用性声称在提升（lifting）到原始博弈时可能发生变化，导致报告结果不可复现。本文旨在揭示这一审计漏洞，并论证披露完整抽象合约的必要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈抽象理论、行为策略、可审计性（auditability）、提升规则（lifting rule）、抽象合约（abstraction contract）。
AI.method: 构造一个最小化可手算验证的案例：两个不同的抽象合约共享相同的抽象博弈G'、抽象策略σ'、固定多对一映射ϕ、惰性ρ和评估E，仅提升规则λ不同（均为ϕ兼容）。比较两个合约下原始博弈的可利用性值。
AI.findings: 在两种不同的提升规则下（λ₁和λ₂），虽然抽象策略相同且均与映射ϕ兼容，原始博弈的可利用性值分别为2.0和4.0，差异显著。这表明仅报告抽象报告R无法保证可利用性结果的可复现性。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确了博弈抽象报告的可审计性条件：必须披露完整抽象合约（C = (G, G', ϕ, λ, ρ, E)），而非仅抽象报告R。提供了关于报告级可审计性（report-level auditability）的极小定理/可复现性注释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为博弈抽象领域的科研报告提供了规范建议：要求研究者披露完整的抽象合约以增强结果的可复现性和可审计性，避免仅依赖抽象报告导致的验证失败。

title: Comparing Data Envelopment Analysis and Stochastic Frontier Analysis for Measuring Odi Bowler Efficiency

detail.title: Comparing Data Envelopment Analysis and Stochastic Frontier Analysis for Measuring Odi Bowler Efficiency
detail.abstract: Background: Traditional cricket bowling indicators such as wickets, economy rate and runs conceded provide useful but incomplete signals of player performance. Efficiency methods can evaluate how bowlers convert available inputs into wicket-taking outputs while also recognising performance variation across match contexts. Purpose: This study measures the relative efficiency of One Day International bowlers in the 2022 season and compares Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) with Stochastic Frontier Analysis (SFA) as alternative analytical approaches. Methods: Secondary performance data for ODI bowlers were analysed using DEA and SFA. DEA models compared variable returns to scale (VRS) and constant returns to scale (CRS) output-oriented specifications, while SFA compared half-normal efficiency estimates under Jondrow-Lovell-Materov-Schmidt and Battese-Coelli estimators. Results: The VRS DEA model produced a mean efficiency score of 49.35 percent and identified six efficient bowlers, while the CRS model produced a lower mean efficiency score of 17.60 percent. Within SFA, the Battese-Coelli half-normal model generated a higher mean efficiency score of 65.41 percent than the Jondrow-Lovell-Materov-Schmidt half-normal estimate of 64.89 percent. The selected SFA model identified Ebadot Hossain as the most efficient bowler in the analysed sample, with an efficiency score of 93.69 percent. Conclusion: SFA offered the more suitable final framework for this dataset because it incorporated stochastic noise and provided stronger efficiency differentiation, while VRS was preferred within the DEA family.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了DEA和SFA两种效率分析方法在2022赛季ODI板球投手表现评估中的应用。
AI.research_question: 如何比较DEA与SFA在衡量ODI板球投手相对效率中的适用性？
AI.motivation: 传统投手指标（如wickets、经济率）信息不完整，需要更科学的效率评估方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数据包络分析（DEA）与随机前沿分析（SFA）的效率测量理论。
AI.method: 使用DEA（VRS与CRS输出导向模型）和SFA（半正态效率估计，比较JLMS与BC两种估计量）分析ODI投手的二手绩效数据。
AI.findings: VRS-DEA平均效率得分49.35%，CRS-DEA为17.60%；SFA中BC半正态模型平均65.41%，JLMS为64.89%；SFA识别Ebadot Hossain为最有效率投手（93.69%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 实证比较了DEA和SFA在板球效率评估中的差异，证明SFA因包含随机噪声而更适合该数据集。
AI.practical_contributions: 为板球运动提供了更科学的投手效率评估方法，有助于球员选拔和战术决策。

title: Sandy Energy: Electroarenal Energy to Produce Electricity from Optical Catalysis by Sand
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Sandy Energy: Electroarenal Energy to Produce Electricity from Optical Catalysis by Sand
detail.abstract: electroarenal energy is third subform of sandy energy subforms that based on optical catalysis producing by active medium (silicon dioxide SiO2 sand 91% (support mass) with + Iron(II) carbonate FeCO3 liquid 3%-Citric acid C6H8O7 liquid 3% (Pre-treatment to gases extraction like steam and CO2 by thermal heating to get Iron(II, III) oxide Fe3O4) and Silicon carbide SiC 2% (to photoabsorptivity) and Bauxite or Mullite 3Al2O3 • 2SiO2 4%to link materials and not do decomposition under thermal cases-) when heating at 1100 C by solar source via parabolic dish covered with reflective mylar sheet or PMMA lenses with Compound Parabolic Concentrator (CPC) with Quartz Window then active medium works as thermal emitter to produce photons, paractive medium (Lead sulfide-PbS above Zinc oxide-ZnO and under PbS Aluminum Heat Sink beside to Liquid Cold Water Channel then Surface Passivation by Potassium iodide KI salt for PbS) works as thermal receiver to receives photons then releases electrons for produce electricity where between thermal emitter and thermal receiver is Fused Quartz Window, because of photon energy for active medium is 0.587 eV then photon energy for paractive-Lead sulfide is 0.13-0.37 eV.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于沙基活性介质（SiO₂为主）与铅硫化物（PbS）接收体的新型光热电能量转换系统，通过太阳能加热至1100°C实现光子发射与电子释放，从而产生电能。
AI.research_question: 如何利用沙基材料（二氧化硅、碳酸亚铁、碳化硅等）构建一种新型光热电能量转换系统，将太阳能转化为电能？
AI.motivation: 探索一种基于沙（SiO₂）作为主要支撑材料的低成本、可获取性强的太阳能能量转换新范式，区别于传统光伏或光热技术。
AI.theoretical_framework: 光催化产热发射理论、半导体光子能量转换（PbS的0.13-0.37 eV与活性介质的0.587 eV匹配）、热电材料表面钝化（KI盐对PbS的钝化）与热管理（铝散热片+冷水通道）。
AI.method: 材料配方设计（SiO₂ 91%+FeCO₃ 3%+柠檬酸3%+SiC 2%+莫来石/铝土矿4%），太阳能抛物面聚光器（带反射膜或PMMA透镜+CPC+石英窗）加热至1100°C，活性介质作为热发射体，PbS/ZnO/Al散热片/冷水通道作为热接收体，KI表面钝化处理。
AI.findings: 活性介质在1100°C加热下发射0.587 eV光子，PbS接收体（0.13-0.37 eV）可接收部分光子并释放电子，形成完整的光-热-电转换链路。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种全新的"沙基光热电能量转换"理论框架，将传统被认为是废弃物的沙转化为功能性光热能量转换介质。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种可能低成本的太阳能发电方案，原材料（沙、铁化合物、碳化硅等）易获取且环境友好，适合在沙漠或沙资源丰富地区应用。

title: INTERPOL’s Jurisdiction over Transnational Commercial Crimes Between Prosecuting Financial Fraud and Preventing the Misuse of Red Notices in Civil Disputes
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: INTERPOL’s Jurisdiction over Transnational Commercial Crimes Between Prosecuting Financial Fraud and Preventing the Misuse of Red Notices in Civil Disputes
detail.abstract: This article examines INTERPOL’s constitutional competence in addressing transnational commercial and financial crimes, particularly fraud, money laundering, and cross-border embezzlement. While Article 2 of the INTERPOL Constitution provides a legitimate basis for international police cooperation against “ordinary-law crime,” serious legal concerns arise when Red Notices are misused in disputes that are essentially civil or contractual in nature.The study highlights the fundamental distinction between criminal commercial fraud and private commercial conflicts, analyzes the adverse human rights consequences of wrongful Red Notices, and emphasizes the oversight role of the Commission for the Control of INTERPOL’s Files (CCF) as an institutional safeguard against abuse. The article concludes by proposing reforms aimed at strengthening evidentiary standards, enhancing transparency, and preventing INTERPOL mechanisms from being transformed into tools of commercial coercion.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了国际刑警组织在处理跨国商业和金融犯罪（如欺诈、洗钱和跨境贪污）方面的宪法权限，指出红色通缉令在民事或合同纠纷中被滥用的法律风险，并提出了加强证据标准、透明度和防止机制被用于商业胁迫的改革建议。
AI.research_question: 国际刑警组织在应对跨国商业和金融犯罪方面是否具备宪法权限？当红色通缉令被滥用于本质上是民事或合同性质的纠纷时，会产生哪些法律与人权问题？
AI.motivation: 商业和金融犯罪的跨国性日益增加，但国际刑警组织的机制可能被滥用于商业胁迫，导致严重的人权后果，亟需厘清法律边界并提出改革方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际刑警组织宪法（尤其是第2条关于"普通法犯罪"的规定）；刑事商业欺诈与民事商业纠纷的区分理论；人权保护框架；机构监督理论（CCF的制衡作用）。
AI.method: 规范分析方法，结合国际刑警组织宪法文本解释、案例分析和制度功能评估。
AI.findings: 国际刑警组织对商业和金融犯罪具有宪法基础，但红色通缉令常被滥用于民事纠纷；滥用行为导致严重的人权后果；CCF作为监督机构起到一定制衡作用但仍有不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 厘清了国际刑警组织在商业犯罪领域的权限边界，明确了"刑事商业欺诈"与"私人民事纠纷"的理论区分标准，丰富了国际组织权力滥用与人权保护的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了加强证据审查标准、提升程序透明度、防止国际刑警机制沦为商业胁迫工具的具体改革建议，对国际刑警组织和成员国具有实践指导意义。

title: Information in (and not in) Interest Rate Surveys
affiliations: University of York - Department of Economics and Related Studies and University of York

detail.title: Information in (and not in) Interest Rate Surveys
detail.abstract: We develop a joint shadow rate term structure model for zero-coupon yields and survey expectations that allows for departures between subjective and objective expectations, arising from biases both in perceived policy responses and in expectations of fundamentals. Using U.S. data, we find evidence of both: reaction function errors at short maturities and probability forecast errors at long maturities. These biases have three main implications. First, not accounting for survey biases can distort inference about the dynamics of observed interest rates. Second, surveys are essential to recover the premium perceived by investors. Third, survey-implied term premia are systematically lower than those inferred from bond prices.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个联合影子利率期限结构模型，结合零息债券收益率和调查预期数据，允许主观预期与客观预期之间存在偏差。研究发现美国数据中存在短期反应函数误差和长期概率预测误差，这些偏差会影响利率动态推断、投资者风险溢价恢复以及期限溢价估计。
AI.research_question: 主观预期与客观预期之间的偏差如何影响利率期限结构的推断？
AI.motivation: 现有期限结构模型通常假设主观预期与客观预期一致，但现实中调查数据显示投资者预期存在系统性偏差，忽视这些偏差可能导致对利率动态和风险溢价的有偏推断。
AI.theoretical_framework: 影子利率期限结构模型；主观与客观预期偏差理论（包括反应函数误差和概率预测误差）。
AI.method: 联合建模零息债券收益率和调查预期的影子利率期限结构模型，允许主观与客观预期存在差异。
AI.findings: （1）短期存在反应函数误差，长期存在概率预测误差；（2）忽视调查偏差会扭曲利率动态推断；（3）调查数据对恢复投资者感知的风险溢价至关重要；（4）调查隐含的期限溢价系统性低于从债券价格推断的期限溢价。
AI.theory_contributions: 将主观预期偏差引入影子利率期限结构模型，区分了反应函数误差和概率预测误差两种偏差类型，揭示了偏差对利率动态和风险溢价推断的理论影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和市场参与者提供了更准确的利率期限结构建模方法，提示在分析利率预期和风险溢价时应纳入调查数据以纠正偏差。

title: Mapping the Hidden Burden: A Geospatial Analysis of Environmental And Social Determinants and Their Association with Pancreatic Cancer Incidence and Mortality in the United States
affiliations: University of Alabama at Birmingham, University of Alabama at Birmingham, University of Alabama at Birmingham, University of Alabama at Birmingham, University of Alabama at Birmingham, University of Alabama at Birmingham, University of Alabama at Birmingham - Institute for Cancer Outcomes and Survivorship, University of Alabama at Birmingham, University of Alabama and University of Alabama at Birmingham - Department of Pediatrics

detail.title: Mapping the Hidden Burden: A Geospatial Analysis of Environmental And Social Determinants and Their Association with Pancreatic Cancer Incidence and Mortality in the United States

declarations.declarationOfInterest: All Authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for this article.

detail.abstract:
Background: Prior studies have shown substantial regional variation in pancreatic cancer incidence and mortality. Understanding how environmental exposures and social vulnerability shape these geographic patterns may reveal actionable drivers of disease burden.

Methods: County-level incidence and mortality data (2017–2022) were obtained from the NIH State Cancer Profiles and CDC Environmental Public Health Tracking Network. Age-adjusted rates were linked with environmental (particulate matter (PM₂.₅), arsenic), behavioral (smoking, obesity, binge drinking), and social vulnerability (social vulnerability index[ SVI]) metrics. Spatial autocorrelation (Global Moran’s I) and hotspot analysis (Getis-Ord Gi*) were performed in ArcGIS Pro. Linear regression, SVI domain decomposition, and urban–rural interaction modeling was conducted to evaluate regional associations between social and environmental determinants and pancreatic cancer incidence and mortality (or whatever you want it to say here). Geographically weighted regression (GWR) assessed regional heterogeneity.

Results: Among 3,143 U.S. counties, the national median age-adjusted incidence rate was 13.8 per 100,000 (IQR 12.4–15.3), with significant spatial clustering (Moran's I = 0.47, p < 0.001). Incidence hotspots concentrated in the Deep South, Appalachia, and the industrial Midwest. Median age-adjusted mortality was 7.65 per 100,000 (IQR 0.0–12.2; Moran's I = 0.42, p < 0.001), extending into Arkansas, Tennessee, and the Carolinas. Counties with elevated mortality showed disproportionately higher social vulnerability and environmental exposures. In multivariable analyses (n = 1,683 counties), incidence was independently associated with PM₂.₅ (β = 0.87, p < 0.001) and obesity (β = 0.79, p < 0.001). Mortality was independently associated with SVI (β = 5.18, p < 0.001), PM₂.₅ (β = 0.46, p < 0.001), and alcohol consumption (β = 13.59, p = 0.014). The model explained 16–18% of geographic variance.

Conclusion: Pancreatic cancer burden clusters in distinct regions due to intersecting environmental, behavioral factors and SVI.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了美国3,143个县级区域（2017-2022年）胰腺癌发病率与死亡率的空间分布，发现深南部、阿巴拉契亚和中西部工业地区为高发热点。PM₂.₅、肥胖、社会脆弱性指数（SVI）和饮酒行为与疾病负担显著相关，空间回归模型解释了16-18%的地理变异。
AI.research_question: 环境暴露和社会脆弱性如何塑造美国胰腺癌发病率和死亡率的区域地理格局？
AI.motivation: 既往研究已显示胰腺癌发病和死亡存在显著区域差异，但环境暴露与社会脆弱性如何共同驱动这些地理模式的机制尚不清楚，识别可干预的风险因素有助于减轻疾病负担。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间流行病学理论、社会决定因素健康理论、环境健康暴露理论
AI.method: 数据来源：NIH州癌症档案、CDC环境公共卫生追踪网络；指标：PM₂.₅、砷、吸烟、肥胖、 binge饮酒、社会脆弱性指数（SVI）；空间分析：全局莫兰指数、Getis-Ord Gi*热点分析；回归分析：线性回归、SVI领域分解、城乡交互模型、地理加权回归（GWR）。
AI.findings: 1）发病率中位数13.8/10万，死亡率中位数7.65/10万，均存在显著空间聚集（莫兰指数分别为0.47和0.42）；2）热点集中在深南部、阿巴拉契亚和中西部工业区；3）死亡率高发县社会脆弱性和环境暴露显著偏高；4）发病率与PM₂.₅（β=0.87）和肥胖（β=0.79）独立相关；5）死亡率与SVI（β=5.18）、PM₂.₅（β=0.46）和饮酒（β=13.59）独立相关；6）模型解释16-18%的地理方差。
AI.theory_contributions: 将社会脆弱性理论与空间流行病学结合，揭示了环境暴露、行为因素和社会脆弱性在胰腺癌区域差异中的交互作用，为地理健康不平等提供了空间维度的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别出深南部等高风险热点区域，提示公共卫生资源应向高社会脆弱性和高PM₂.₅暴露地区倾斜；PM₂.₅、肥胖、饮酒等可干预因素为精准预防策略提供了靶点。

title: The Impact of U.S. Critical Audit Matter Disclosure on Firms' Credit Ratings
affiliations: Queen's University Belfast - Queen's Management School and Queen's University Belfast

detail.title: The Impact of U.S. Critical Audit Matter Disclosure on Firms' Credit Ratings
detail.abstract:
Purpose – This paper examines the informativeness of U.S. critical audit matter (CAM) disclosure to credit rating agencies (CRAs) as sophisticated beneficiaries of audited financial statements. It investigates the impact of CAM disclosure—mandated by the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (PCAOB) to highlight high-risk areas—on firms’ credit ratings.

Design/methodology/approach – We conduct multivariate analysis of CAM effects on a firm’s credit rating through ologit regressions (credit rating analysis), logit models (investment versus speculative-grade analysis), intertemporal (within-firm) change analyses, and quasi-experimental difference-in-differences specifications. We conduct our tests using a sample of U.S. companies that adopt CAM disclosures and employ both a control group of nonadopters and a propensity score-matched group of economically comparable nonadopters. Main tests use S&P long-term issuer credit ratings, with additional robustness checks utilizing Fitch ratings.

Findings – After controlling for firm characteristics and corporate governance attributes, we document that CAM disclosure negatively affects firms’ credit ratings. Our results are robust to endogeneity concerns and various estimation procedures, providing novel evidence that the new requirement of CAM disclosure is associated with significant consequences for preparers and users of financial reports, particularly regarding credit rating assessments.

Originality – This research advances the literature on expanded audit reports by providing the first empirical evidence that CAM disclosures are informative to CRAs, bridging the gap between studies focused on market reactions and those on experimental assessments of audit information. It highlights the direct impact of CAM disclosures on credit ratings, supporting the usefulness of expanded auditor reporting for sophisticated users of financial statements.

Practical implications – The evidence-based insights from this study demonstrate that CAM disclosures have significant implications for credit risk assessments, making them relevant to auditors, preparers and users of financial reports, policymakers and regulatory bodies, specifically the PCAOB, Financial Reporting Council (FRC), and International Auditing and Assurance Standard Board (IAASB).

AI.tldr: 本文研究了美国关键审计事项（CAM）披露对信用评级机构（CRAs）的信息含量，发现CAM披露会负面影响企业信用评级，为扩大审计报告的信息有用性提供了新证据。
AI.research_question: 关键审计事项（CAM）披露是否向信用评级机构（CRAs）传递了信息？CAM披露如何影响企业的信用评级？
AI.motivation: PCAOB强制要求CAM披露以突出高风险领域，但已有研究主要关注市场反应或实验性评估，缺乏对信用评级机构这一财务报告高级使用者角度的实证证据。因此，本文旨在填补该空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 审计报告信息含量理论、信用评级决定因素理论、信号理论
AI.method: 采用多元回归分析：有序逻辑回归（信用评级分析）、逻辑模型（投资级与投机级分析）、企业内时间变化分析、准实验双重差分规范。使用美国采用CAM披露的公司作为样本，以未采用者及倾向得分匹配的经济可比非采用者作为对照组。主要使用S&P长期发行人信用评级，辅以Fitch评级做稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 在控制公司特征和公司治理属性后，CAM披露对企业信用评级产生负面影响。结果在应对内生性问题及多种估计方法下稳健，表明CAM披露新要求对财务报告编制者和使用者（尤其是信用评级评估）具有显著后果。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供CAM披露对信用评级机构具有信息含量的实证证据，将市场反应研究与实验性评估研究联系起来，拓展了扩大审计报告相关文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 证明CAM披露对信用风险评估具有重要影响，对审计师、财务报告编制者与使用者、政策制定者及监管机构（如PCAOB、FRC、IAASB）具有现实参考价值。

title: Exchange Rate Predictability from Monetary Policy Path Expectations: Evidence from OIS Slopes
affiliations: Yokohama City University and Yokohama City University - Graduate School of International Management

detail.title: Exchange Rate Predictability from Monetary Policy Path Expectations: Evidence from OIS Slopes
detail.abstract: This paper studies how revisions in expected monetary policy paths affect exchange rates. We construct a slope factor from one-month and twelve-month Overnight Index Swap (OIS) rates to capture policy-path news embedded in short-term interest rate markets. Using weekly data from 2008 to 2025, we show that increases in the U.S. slope predict subsequent appreciations of the U.S. dollar, consistent with the role of U.S. monetary policy as a global anchor for financial markets. This predictability weakens during high-attention periods, such as FOMC weeks, suggesting that policy-path information is incorporated more rapidly into exchange rates when market attention is elevated. We further examine the role of central bank communication by constructing a text-based Hawk-Dove Index from FOMC speeches. A more hawkish speech tone is associated with a flattening of the U.S. slope, reflecting a stronger response of one-month OIS rates than twelve-month OIS rates. We interpret these findings using a simple framework with time-varying information frictions, in which policy-path news is incorporated gradually in normal periods but more rapidly during high-attention events.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，美国货币政策路径预期的斜率因子（一个月与十二个月OIS利差）能预测美元升值，且这种可预测性在FOMC等高度关注时期减弱。此外，美联储鹰派言论会 flatten 美国利率斜率，表明短期利率对政策路径信息反应更敏感。
AI.research_question: 货币政策路径预期修正如何影响汇率？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对货币政策公告的即期汇率效应研究较多，但政策路径预期（而非单一利率决策）对汇率的动态影响尚不清晰，尤其缺乏对信息摩擦和市场关注度作用的考察。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时变信息摩擦理论（time-varying information frictions）：政策路径信息在正常时期逐渐融入价格，而在高关注事件期间被快速吸收。
AI.method: 构建OIS斜率因子（一个月与十二个月OIS利差）；采用2008-2025年周度数据；使用文本分析方法构建FOMC演讲的鹰鸽指数（Hawk-Dove Index）。
AI.findings: （1）美国OIS斜率上升预测美元升值；（2）FOMC周等高度关注时期，这种可预测性减弱；（3）鹰派演讲 flatten 美国斜率，因为一个月OIS反应大于十二个月OIS。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从政策路径预期修正角度揭示汇率动态，并引入时变信息摩擦解释汇率对货币政策新闻的反应速度差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和央行提供预测汇率走势的斜率指标；提示政策沟通需关注市场关注度对信息传导效率的影响。

title: The Varoka Multiplier

detail.title: The Varoka Multiplier

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known financial interests, personal relationships, or external affiliations that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. The concepts, analyses, and views presented in “The Varoka Multiplier” are solely those of the author and are based on independent research, professional industrial experience, and publicly available economic and geopolitical data sources. The author is involved in manufacturing and industrial business activities within the GCC region; however, no external organization, government entity, financial institution, or commercial party funded, directed, or influenced the preparation of this research paper. No conflicts of interest are declared.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research paper did not involve human participants, patients, clinical data, animal testing, or experimental interventions requiring ethics committee approval. The study is based solely on independent analytical research, publicly available data sources, economic analysis, and theoretical framework development. Therefore, formal ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: his research received no external funding. The paper was independently developed and authored by Janbi Varoka (Zhanbi Khadj omar) based on personal research, professional experience in manufacturing and industrial strategy, and analysis of publicly available economic, geopolitical, and technological data sources.

detail.abstract: This paper introduces version 3.0 of the Varoka Multiplier-formally, the Varoka Compound Efficiency Theory-an eight-factor analytical framework for measuring the structural competitive advantage of emerging economies in technology-intensive production. I argue that the cost gap practitioners observe between countries like China and the United States is not a single-variable story. It is a compound. When wage differentials, currency undervaluation, talent depth, execution speed, energy cost, data liquidity, capital efficiency, and ecosystem density all act on the same dollar at once, the result is not addition. It is multiplication. The eight factors-α (wage ratio), β (PPP amplification), γ (talent density), δ (execution speed), ε (energy cost inverse), ζ (data liquidity), κ (capital efficiency), and η (ecosystem density) are each independently measurable using publicly available data. I weight the product by an output-quality adjustment Q and divide by a risk-drag denominator R, producing what I call the Net Varoka Multiplier (VM₃). Applied to the China-United States technology labor market in 2026, the framework yields a gross multiplier of approximately 17x and a risk-adjusted, decorrelated multiplier of roughly 10x meaning each dollar invested in an integrated engineering stack in China generates 10 to 17 dollars of comparable productive capacity in the United States. A parallel India-U.S. estimate (~8x gross, ~5x decorrelated) demonstrates that the framework discriminates correctly between sectors and geographies. I close with a discussion of why artificial intelligence reinforces, rather than neutralises, this compound-and what that means for the next decade of global competition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Varoka复合效率理论（Varoka乘数3.0），构建了一个八因子分析框架，用于衡量新兴经济体在技术密集型生产中的结构性竞争优势。通过量化中美印三国的成本乘数效应，论证了"成本优势是复合乘法而非简单加法"的核心观点。
AI.research_question: 新兴经济体（尤其是中国）在技术密集型生产中相对于发达国家的结构性竞争优势如何量化？其背后的复合机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常用单一变量（如工资差异）解释成本优势，但这种简化忽略了多因素协同放大的复合效应。作者试图构建一个更全面、可量化的框架来揭示真实竞争格局。
AI.theoretical_framework: Varoka复合效率理论：八因子模型——α（工资比率）、β（购买力平价放大）、γ（人才密度）、δ（执行速度）、ε（能源成本倒数）、ζ（数据流动性）、κ（资本效率）、η（生态系统密度）。输出质量调整因子Q和风险拖拽因子R构成了最终净Varoka乘数（VM₃）。
AI.method: 构建八因子复合乘数模型，使用公开可获取的数据对各因子进行独立测量，通过乘积形式计算总乘数，并以输出质量调整和风险修正得到净乘数。对中美（2026年）及印美进行实证估算。
AI.findings: 中美技术劳动力市场：总乘数约17x，风险调整后约10x（即在中国投入1美元相当于在美国产生10-17美元的生产能力）；印美：总乘数约8x，风险调整后约5x。AI技术会强化而非削弱这一复合优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"成本优势乘法复合"的新理论视角，超越了传统的单一变量比较范式；构建了首个包含生态密度、数据流动性等新型因子的综合量化框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为跨国投资选址、供应链决策提供了可量化的评估工具；警示西方政策制定者：简单的关税或补贴难以抵消多重因子乘积效应带来的结构性优势。

title: Divergent Minds, Convergent Baselines: A Bounded-Rationality Account of LLM-Human Strategic Behaviour

detail.title: Divergent Minds, Convergent Baselines: A Bounded-Rationality Account of LLM-Human Strategic Behaviour

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests. The research was conducted independently and does not evaluate or promote any specific commercial product.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This research is purely theoretical and involves no human or animal subjects. The empirical evidence cited is drawn from published academic literature
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Researchers have started using LLM agents in place of human subjects in behavioural and politicalscience experiments, often as a cheaper substitute for laboratory pools. The substitution does not hold up in strategic settings: humans and LLMs reliably make different choices, and neither fine-tuning on human response data nor persona conditioning has closed the gap. The behavioural-economics literature has, since Simon's introduction of bounded rationality, modelled human strategic behaviour as a classical baseline plus an additive correction term δ. The framework proposed here reads δ as the mathematical signature of bounded computation: the gap between what an unboundedly-rational agent would compute and what a computationally bounded agent actually produces. For canonical games whose solutions are present in standard training corpora, LLMs retrieve and recombine corpus material, bypassing the bound that produces δ in humans. The framing extends to reasoning-distilled models through cognitive-hierarchy theory: their accessible level-k strategic reasoning is bounded by compute budget and context length rather than by the cognitive constraints that bound humans, and the δ they produce, if any, carries different structural signatures. Four operational tests (conditional dependence, distributional asymmetry, path-dependence under repetition, and paraphrase-robustness) are proposed to discriminate human-shaped δ from LLM-shaped δ. A moderator prediction is that |δ| scales with peer-signal individuation in the decision environment, with a quantitative bound of Cohen's d ≥ 0.5 between named-opponent and aggregate-opponent settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套理论框架和实证检验方法，区分人类与LLM在策略性博弈中的行为差异。核心观点是：人类行为偏离理性基准的δ项源于**有界计算**（bounded computation），而LLM的δ（若有）源于**计算预算和上下文长度限制**，两者具有不同的结构特征。作者提出了四项可操作检验和一个调节效应预测来区分二者。
AI.research_question: 如何在策略性博弈中区分人类与LLM的行为差异，并从理论上解释这种差异的本质？
AI.motivation: 研究者开始用LLM代理替代人类被试进行行为与政治科学实验，但这种替代在策略性情境下并不成立——人类与LLM的决策系统性不同，且微调与角色提示无法弥合差距。需要从理论上理解差异根源，并提供可操作的判别方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. **有界计算框架**：将行为经济学中人类偏离理性基准的δ重新概念化为有界计算的数学印记——无限理性智能体本应计算的结果与有界计算主体实际产出之间的差距。2. **认知层级理论（Cognitive Hierarchy Theory）**：用于解释推理蒸馏模型（reasoning-distilled models）的k级策略推理，这些模型的界限来自计算预算和上下文长度，而非人类认知约束。
AI.method: 理论建构 + 四项操作性检验方法（条件依赖性、分布不对称性、重复博弈下的路径依赖性、释义稳健性）+ 调节效应预测（|δ|随同伴信号个性化程度递增，命名对手与聚合对手情境间Cohen's d ≥ 0.5）。
AI.findings: 1. 人类与LLM在策略性博弈中的系统性差异无法通过微调或角色提示消除；2. 对于训练语料中存在的经典博弈解法，LLM直接检索和重组语料，绕过了产生人类δ的有界计算过程；3. 人类δ与LLM的δ（如果有）具有不同的结构特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将行为经济学中的δ项重新解释为有界计算的数学印记，为人类与AI行为差异提供了统一理论框架；2. 将认知层级理论扩展到推理蒸馏模型的分析中；3. 提出了区分人类与AI行为偏差的可操作性检验方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为研究者判断是否可以在实验中用LLM替代人类被试提供了可操作的判别标准；2. 提供了四项具体检验方法，帮助实验设计者识别行为数据来源（人类还是LLM）；3. 指出了未来用LLM模拟人类行为的边界条件，尤其是个性化对手信息的重要性。

title: Genetic K-Means for Missing-Value Imputation
affiliations: Universidade Federal Fluminense, Universidade Federal Fluminense, Universidade Federal Fluminense and Universidade Federal Fluminense

detail.title: Genetic K-Means for Missing-Value Imputation
detail.abstract: This study examines whether missing-value imputation in K-means clustering can be reformulated as an optimization problem guided by clustering quality. To address this question, the paper proposes Genetic K-means, a hybrid framework in which a Genetic Algorithm searches the space of candidate imputations and evaluates each solution through the Silhouette score obtained after applying K-means. The method was tested on three benchmark datasets from the UCI repository after inducing artificial missingness under an MCAR mechanism at 5\%, 10\%, and 20\%. Its performance was compared with min-max value replacements, mean filling, and k-Nearest Neighbors imputation using both Silhouette score and RMSE. Across all three datasets and all missingness levels, Genetic K-means achieved the highest Silhouette values, including 0.7154, 0.6744, and 0.5631 for Wholesale Customers, 0.2044, 0.2853, and 0.2433 for Travel Reviews, and 0.2675, 0.2894, and 0.3122 for Cervical Cancer Behavior Risk. In contrast, it did not consistently attain the lowest RMSE. These findings indicate that reconstruction accuracy and clustering adequacy are not equivalent objectives. The originality of the study lies in introducing an imputation framework for unsupervised learning in which evolutionary search is explicitly aligned with structure-preserving clustering performance, thereby extending missing-data treatment beyond conventional reconstruction-oriented logic.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于遗传算法与K-means聚类的混合框架（Genetic K-means），将缺失值插补重构为以聚类质量为导向的优化问题，实验证明该方法在三个UCI基准数据集上均获得了最高的轮廓系数，但并未持续取得最低的RMSE，表明重构准确性与聚类充分性并非等价目标。
AI.research_question: K-means聚类中的缺失值插补能否被重新表述为一个以聚类质量为导向的优化问题？
AI.motivation: 传统缺失值插补方法多以重构准确性（如RMSE）为目标，忽略了在无监督学习场景下聚类任务本身对数据质量的需求，需要探索一种直接以聚类质量为优化目标的插补方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 遗传算法（GA）用于搜索候选插补空间；K-means聚类用于评估插补结果；轮廓系数（Silhouette score）作为聚类质量的评价指标。
AI.method: 提出Genetic K-means混合框架，使用遗传算法搜索插补方案，以K-means聚类后的轮廓系数作为适应度函数；在三个UCI数据集（Wholesale Customers、Travel Reviews、Cervical Cancer Behavior Risk）上，在MCAR机制下诱导5%、10%、20%的缺失率，与最小值-最大值替换、均值填补、k近邻插补等方法进行对比。
AI.findings: Genetic K-means在所有数据集和缺失率下均获得最高轮廓系数（如Wholesale Customers数据集上分别为0.7154、0.6744、0.5631），但并未持续获得最低RMSE，说明聚类充分性与重构准确性是两个不同的优化目标。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将无监督学习中的缺失值插补问题明确重构为以聚类质量为目标的优化问题，将进化搜索与保持聚类结构的表现直接对齐，突破了传统以重构为导向的缺失数据处理逻辑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为聚类分析中的缺失数据处理提供了一种新的、以聚类效果为导向的插补框架，尤其适用于聚类任务优先于数据重构的场景。

title: Digital Dualism: Platform Capitalism, Informality, and Structural Transformation in the Global South
affiliations: Imperial College London

detail.title: Digital Dualism: Platform Capitalism, Informality, and Structural Transformation in the Global South
detail.abstract: Rapid digitalization has transformed markets across the Global South, yet its developmental consequences remain deeply uneven. In many late-industrializing economies, the expansion of digital platforms has occurred alongside persistent informality, weak productivity growth, and increasing concentration of economic power. This paper develops the concept of digital dualism to explain this configuration. Bringing structural transformation theory into dialogue with the political economy of platform capitalism, the paper argues that digitalization may only reorganize rather than overcome dualistic economic structures. Network effects, data advantages, and global platform governance concentrate value capture within a small number of firms, while limited labour absorption and uneven productivity diffusion leave large segments of the workforce in low-productivity informal activities. These dynamics are illustrated through cross-country stylized evidence and comparative analysis of India and Brazil. The paper contributes to debates on digital capitalism and development by showing how digital expansion can reinforce existing hierarchies while generating new forms of concentration and dependency in late-industrializing economies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"数字二元性"概念，论证数字化转型可能重组而非克服全球南方国家的二元经济结构，通过网络效应、数据优势和平台治理，数字平台加剧了价值集中、劳动力吸纳有限和生产力扩散不均，并以印度和巴西为例进行实证分析。
AI.research_question: 在快速数字化的背景下，全球南方国家（尤其是晚期工业化经济体）的数字平台扩张如何影响其二元经济结构？数字化转型是否能够克服抑或只是重组了既有的经济二元性？
AI.motivation: 全球南方国家数字化快速发展，但其发展后果极不平衡——非正规经济持续存在、生产率增长乏力、经济权力日益集中。现有文献对数字化转型如何与这些结构性特征相互作用缺乏系统解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构转型理论（二元经济理论）与平台资本主义政治经济学的对话。核心概念为"数字二元性"（digital dualism）。
AI.method: 跨国概览性证据（stylized evidence）与印度和巴西的比较案例分析。
AI.findings: 数字化转型并未克服二元经济结构，而是以新的形式重组了二元性。网络效应、数据优势和全球平台治理机制导致价值捕获集中在少数企业，劳动力吸纳有限，生产率扩散不均，大量劳动力仍滞留于低生产率非正规部门。
AI.theory_contributions: 1.提出"数字二元性"概念，将结构转型理论拓展到数字经济时代；2.揭示了数字资本主义在晚期工业化经济体中同时强化既有等级制和产生新型集中与依赖关系的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为全球南方国家制定数字发展战略提供理论框架和实证依据，提示政策制定者应关注数字化转型可能带来的不平等加剧和新型依附关系风险。

title: Implementation and evaluation of an operational seasonal precipitation forecasting system for Cuba using PyCPT
affiliations: University of Havana, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Implementation and evaluation of an operational seasonal precipitation forecasting system for Cuba using PyCPT
detail.abstract: Seasonal precipitation forecasts are a key component of climate services in Cuba, where rainfall variability affects agriculture, water management, drought monitoring, public health, and disaster risk reduction. This study presents the implementation and evaluation of an operational forecasting framework based on the Python Climate Predictability Tool (PyCPT), using CFSv2 predictors and the national Solvaz gridded dataset as predictand. CCA and PCR statistical approaches were compared, evaluating five predictors from lead 0 to lead 6 months: Atlantic sea surface temperature (ASST), outgoing longwave radiation (OLR), temperature at 850 hPa (T850), zonal wind at 200 hPa (200UA), and zonal wind at 30 hPa (30UA). Verification combines deterministic and probabilistic metrics with climatological diagnostics to assess reproduction of the known seasonal behavior of Cuban rainfall. Both methods reproduce the observed annual cycle, including the dry-season minimum and the rapid onset of the rainy season. Forecast skill is strongly season-dependent: MAM, JJA, and SON show the most useful skill, while DJF remains challenging because precipitation is episodic and driven by extratropical disturbances. The skillful predictors are physically consistent with dominant rainfall mechanisms: OLR, T850, and 200UA contribute substantially during the rainy season, reflecting tropical convection, lower-tropospheric thermodynamics, and upper-level circulation; ASST contributes in selected months; and 30UA has weaker relevance. An operational example for 2021 illustrates the system capacity to reproduce broad seasonal structures while revealing positive biases during wet-season months. Overall, PyCPT provides a reproducible and physically interpretable framework for seasonal precipitation forecasting in Cuba and a basis for strengthening Caribbean climate services.

AI.tldr: 本文基于Python气候可预测性工具(PyCPT)，利用CFSv2预测因子和古巴Solvaz网格数据集，构建并评估了古巴季节性降水预报框架，发现CCA和PCR方法均能复现降水的年周期，预报技巧具有强季节性依赖，OLR、T850和200UA是雨季的关键预测因子。
AI.research_question: 如何构建和评估一个基于PyCPT的古巴季节性降水业务预报框架？
AI.motivation: 古巴降水变率影响农业、水资源管理、干旱监测、公共卫生和减灾等多个领域，季节性降水预报是气候服务的核心组成部分，但目前缺乏基于PyCPT的标准化预报框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 典型相关分析(CCA)与主成分回归(PCR)统计降尺度方法；物理一致性：热带对流(OLR)、低层热力学(T850)、高层环流(200UA)与大西洋海温(ASST)在降水机制中的作用。
AI.method: 使用PyCPT框架，以CFSv2的5个预测因子(ASST, OLR, T850, 200UA, 30UA)为自变量，Solvaz网格降水数据为因变量，从超前0-6个月进行对比分析CCA和PCR两种方法，并采用确定性和概率性指标进行验证。
AI.findings: 两种方法均能复现古巴降水的年周期（包括干旱期最低值和雨季快速开始）；预报技巧强季节依赖，MAM、JJA、SON技巧最高，DJF最具挑战性；OLR、T850和200UA在雨季贡献显著，ASST在部分月份有贡献，30UA相关性较弱；2021年业务例显示系统能复现大尺度季节结构但存在湿季正偏差。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了CCA和PCR统计降尺度方法在热带岛屿季节性降水预报中的适用性，揭示了不同物理过程的预测因子在不同季节的贡献差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为古巴提供了可复现、可物理解释的季节性降水预报操作框架，有助于加强加勒比地区气候服务能力。

title: A Multi-Objective Machine Learning Approach for Crash Severity Prediction under Class Imbalance in Less-Regulated Driving Environments
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: A Multi-Objective Machine Learning Approach for Crash Severity Prediction under Class Imbalance in Less-Regulated Driving Environments
detail.abstract: Predicting crash injury severity from imbalanced data is a safety-critical problem that has direct implications for emergency response, enforcement prioritisation, and intelligent transport systems. One of the challenges that has not been fully explored is that balanced recognition across all severity classes and reliable detection of the rare fatal class are competing objectives, such that no single model can achieve both at the same time. Yet, most existing methods are tuned to a single performance metric. This paper proposes a multi-objective machine learning approach for crash severity prediction and develops BACS-Hybrid, a geometric-mean-optimised cost-sensitive hybrid ensemble that blends adaptive synthetic sampling, inverse-frequency class-cost weighting, and validation-driven ensemble aggregation. The proposed approach is tested against fifty-one configurations spanning five method families, and a Pareto efficiency analysis is used to characterise the trade-off between geometric-mean (G-mean) optimisation and fatal-class recall. The results suggest that BACS-Hybrid lies on the Pareto-optimal frontier; it attains the highest fatal-class recall (49.92%) among configurations with competitive G-mean, while cost-sensitive tree models remain strongest for balanced G-mean (Weighted Extra Trees, 44.23%). The McNemar test confirms that the differences are statistically significant (p < 0.001), and an ablation analysis shows that linear-interpolation oversampling degrades G-mean by 1.88 percentage points on binary crash features, which is a finding relevant to synthetic sampling for all-categorical data. The study provides a deployable decision framework in which model selection is driven by the operational objective rather than a single leaderboard metric. Practical guidance is also provided for road safety agencies in less-regulated, low- and middle-income environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BACS-Hybrid多目标机器学习方法，在车祸严重程度预测中平衡整体G-mean与致命类召回率，通过Pareto效率分析揭示两者存在竞争关系，并提供可部署的决策框架。
AI.research_question: 如何在不平衡数据中同时优化车祸严重程度预测的整体平衡准确率（G-mean）和罕见致命类的召回率？
AI.motivation: 现有方法多针对单一性能指标调优，忽视了平衡识别所有严重等级与可靠检测罕见致命类之间是竞争目标，无法同时实现两者最优。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多目标优化理论、Pareto效率分析、代价敏感学习、集成学习、自适应合成采样。
AI.method: 提出BACS-Hybrid混合集成方法，结合自适应合成采样（ADASYN）、逆频率类别权重、验证驱动集成聚合；与51种配置（5类方法家族）对比，采用Pareto前沿分析、McNemar统计检验和消融分析。
AI.findings: BACS-Hybrid位于Pareto最优前沿，在G-mean有竞争力时致命类召回率最高（49.92%）；代价敏感树模型（加权Extra Trees）在平衡G-mean上最强（44.23%）；线性插值过采样在二值特征上使G-mean降低1.88个百分点。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了严重度预测中G-mean与致命类召回率之间的竞争关系，将其形式化为多目标优化问题；发现线性插值过采样对全类别型数据的性能损害机理。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供基于操作目标的模型选择决策框架，替代单一指标排名；为低中收入环境下的道路安全机构提供可部署的实践指导。

title: When More Data Is Not More Truth: The Effect of GAIN-Based Imputation on Prediction and Inference in Clinical Risk Models
affiliations: The University of Winnipeg, The University of Winnipeg, Anhui University, Monash University - Monash University Malaysia, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: When More Data Is Not More Truth: The Effect of GAIN-Based Imputation on Prediction and Inference in Clinical Risk Models
detail.abstract: Generative Adversarial Imputation Networks (GAIN) are increasingly used to address missing data and improve clinical prediction models, yet whether GAIN-imputed data preserve reliable statistical inference remains unclear. This study evaluated the trade-off between predictive performance and inferential validity in hypertension risk modeling by comparing an original complete-case dataset (n = 19,860) with a GAIN-imputed dataset (n = 31,072). LASSO, generalized linear modeling (GLM), and XGBoost were applied. Model performance was assessed using area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), calibration curves, and decision curve analysis, while interpretability and stability were evaluated using adjusted odds ratios, SHAP values, Bland–Altman analysis, and bootstrap resampling. GAIN-based imputation improved predictive performance across all models, with the largest improvement observed in XGBoost (AUC: 0.752 to 0.801), accompanied by improved calibration and clinical utility. However, improved prediction did not ensure reliable inference. Several biomarkers demonstrated attenuation, inflation, or reversal of adjusted odds ratio direction after imputation. Potassium shifted from protective to risk-associated, while albumin and total calcium also showed directional reversal. Magnesium further highlighted the limitation of linear inference: although GLM suggested a positive association, SHAP dependence analysis revealed a nonlinear U-shaped relationship. These findings demonstrate that GAIN-based imputation can enhance prediction while distorting statistical inference. We propose a dual-pipeline framework in which GAIN-imputed data are used for prediction-oriented modeling, whereas original complete-case data remain the primary reference for regression-based inference and biomarker interpretation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究GAIM插补在高血压风险建模中提升预测性能但扭曲统计推断的问题，提出预测用插补数据、推断用原始完整数据的双管道框架。
AI.research_question: GAIN插补数据在提升临床预测模型性能的同时，是否还能保留可靠的统计推断能力？
AI.motivation: GAIN被广泛用于处理缺失数据以改进临床预测模型，但其对统计推断有效性的影响尚不明确，存在预测性能与推断准确性之间的权衡问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生成对抗插补网络（GAIN）；统计推断与预测性能的权衡理论；SHAP可解释性分析；Bland-Altman一致性分析。
AI.method: 比较原始完整数据集（n=19,860）与GAIN插补数据集（n=31,072），使用LASSO、GLM、XGBoost三种模型，通过AUC、校准曲线、决策曲线分析评估性能，利用调整后OR值、SHAP值、Bland-Altman分析和bootstrap重抽样评估可解释性与稳定性。
AI.findings: GAIN插补提升了所有模型的预测性能（XGBoost AUC从0.752提升至0.801），但导致多个生物标志物的调整后OR值方向发生逆转（如钾从保护因素变为风险因素，白蛋白和总钙也出现方向逆转），且镁呈现非线性U型关系，表明线性推断存在局限性。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了GAIN插补在提升预测性能与保持统计推断有效性之间存在根本性矛盾，提出了预测与推断分离的双管道分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为临床研究者提供了明确的操作指南：GAIN插补数据应用于预测建模，原始完整数据应作为回归推断和生物标志物解读的主要参考，避免因插补导致的错误临床结论。

title: Conditions for the Competitiveness of the Agricultural Sector in the EU, Japan, Canada, Vietnam, and Mercosur Countries
affiliations: Poznań University of Life Sciences

detail.title: Conditions for the Competitiveness of the Agricultural Sector in the EU, Japan, Canada, Vietnam, and Mercosur Countries
detail.abstract: The main purpose of this paper was to identify the resource conditions for the competitiveness of the agricultural sector in the European Union (EU), Japan, Canada, Vietnam, and Mercosur countries. The study proved that these countries demonstrate a strong competitive potential. The largest labor resources are found in the Vietnamese agriculture, even though it has witnessed an outflow of 40% of its workforce over the recent years. The EU exhibits high levels of gross fixed capital formation in the agricultural sector. Conversely, the Vietnamese agriculture recorded the fastest growth in capital expenditure. Canada and Mercosur countries have a considerable area of agricultural land and a concentrated agrarian structure, and thus can benefit from economies of scale which, in turn, determine their global competitiveness. It is the opposite in Japan and Vietnam, with over 90% of farms having an area up to 5 ha.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了欧盟、日本、加拿大、越南和南方共同市场国家农业部门竞争力的资源条件，发现不同国家在劳动力、资本、土地等资源禀赋上各具优势，共同构成了农业竞争力的基础。
AI.research_question: 这些国家农业部门竞争力的资源条件是什么？不同国家的农业资源禀赋如何影响其全球竞争力？
AI.motivation: 识别不同国家和地区农业竞争力的关键资源条件，为农业政策制定和资源优化配置提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 农业竞争力理论、资源基础理论、规模经济理论
AI.method: 比较分析法，对欧盟、日本、加拿大、越南和南方共同市场国家的农业劳动力、资本形成、土地资源等指标进行跨国比较。
AI.findings: （1）越南农业劳动力资源最丰富，但近年外流40%；（2）欧盟农业固定资产形成总额最高；（3）越南农业资本支出增速最快；（4）加拿大和南方共同市场国家土地面积广阔、农业结构集中，享有规模经济优势；（5）日本和越南90%以上农场面积小于5公顷，缺乏规模经济。
AI.theory_contributions: 实证揭示了不同资源禀赋（劳动力、资本、土地）对农业竞争力的差异化作用机制，丰富了农业竞争力的资源基础理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各国农业政策制定提供参考：欧盟应继续加强资本投入，越南需应对劳动力流失并推动规模经营，日本需优化小农结构，加拿大和南方共同市场国家可继续发挥规模优势。

title: Expected Utility and Prospect Theories Versus Agricultural Insurance
affiliations: National Research Institute - Institute of Agricultural and Food Economics - National Research Institute (IAFE-NRI)

detail.title: Expected Utility and Prospect Theories Versus Agricultural Insurance
detail.abstract: The expected utility theory/hypothesis (EUT/ET) by von Neumann and Morgenstern has become the subject of criticism and efforts to improve it already at the moment of presenting its complete axiomatic form (1953). The broadest analysis was carried out by Kahneman and Tversky using the prospect theory (PT). However, it was not carefully prepared. The above two were helped in 1982 by Quiggin with his extension of the EUT in the form of the rank-dependent expected utility (RDEU). This was followed by Kahneman and Tversky in 1992 boasted the second version of the prospect theory, i.e., the cumulative prospect theory (CPT). It became the most competitive proposal to the EUT, although later other researchers added new elements to it. In this way, the subsequent generations of the PT were created. Today there are five in total. It soon became apparent that the PT also did not satisfactorily explain various cases of decision-making under conditions of risk and uncertainty. Upon closer analysis, however, it turned out that the PT was in fact a generalization of the EUT. Both theories are tools for modeling insurance decisions, including agriculture. In this context, the main aim of the article is to present the principles and the results of applying them in agricultural insurance. The analysis shows that the pragmatic solution at present is the combined use of both theories, with the EUT usually being the reference point.

AI.tldr: 本文梳理了期望效用理论（EUT）与前景理论（PT）及其后续版本（累积前景理论CPT等）的演变关系，指出PT实际上是EUT的推广，并探讨了二者在农业保险决策中的联合应用，发现以EUT为基准、结合使用两种理论是当前的务实方案。
AI.research_question: 期望效用理论与前景理论及其衍生版本在农业保险决策中如何应用？两种理论的关系是什么？
AI.motivation: 期望效用理论自提出以来不断受到批评和改进，前景理论虽然成为最具竞争力的替代方案，但仍无法完全解释风险与不确定性下的决策行为。在农业保险领域，需要厘清这两种理论的关系及联合应用的可能性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 期望效用理论（EUT）、前景理论（PT）、累积前景理论（CPT）、等级依赖期望效用理论（RDEU）
AI.method: 理论梳理与比较分析，结合农业保险领域的应用案例进行评述。
AI.findings: 前景理论实际上是期望效用理论的推广；两者均可用于农业保险决策建模；当前最务实的做法是将两种理论结合使用，并以期望效用理论作为基准参考点。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确了期望效用理论与前景理论之间的广义化关系，而非简单的替代关系；梳理了前景理论五代演进的脉络。
AI.practical_contributions: 为农业保险决策建模提供了理论选择指导，提出联合使用两种理论的务实方案。

title: ESG Investing in the 21 st Century: Promise, Performance, and Perception
affiliations: The Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda and The Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda

detail.title: ESG Investing in the 21 st Century: Promise, Performance, and Perception
detail.abstract: Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) investing has become a paradigm shift in the contemporary financial markets to combine the concept of sustainability with the traditional methods of investment. This chapter thoroughly analyses ESG investing in terms of its conception, financial performance, role of risk management and perception and behaviour of investors. It also examines the literature available and establishes critical research gaps on the issue of standardization, data reliability and new market dynamics. The research also discusses the ESG measurement, data issues, including the issue of inconsistency in ESG ratings and greenwashing. Also, it examines ESG financial products and instruments, such as green bonds and ESG funds, and international regulatory frameworks, which facilitate transparency and accountability. An empirical study of the trends in the ESG markets shows the high pace of ESG asset growth, rising inflows of funds, and growing their use across the world. The chapter further assesses the practical effect of ESG, especially in the emerging markets, and the future trend that defines sustainable finance. This research can be beneficial to the investor, researchers, and policymakers because it offers insights into how the ESG factors can be utilized to improve the long-term financial performance and better risk management, and sustainable economic development. Generally, ESG investing will be instrumental in determining investment plans in the future.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了ESG投资的理念、财务表现、风险管理及投资者行为，指出标准化不足、数据可靠性等研究缺口，并通过实证研究展示ESG资产的高速增长趋势，认为ESG投资将塑造未来投资策略。
AI.research_question: ESG投资如何与可持续性概念融合？其在财务表现、风险管理、投资者行为方面存在哪些特征与挑战？
AI.motivation: ESG投资已成为金融市场范式转变的核心趋势，但标准化缺失、数据可靠性差、评级不一致及"漂绿"等问题亟待解决，需系统梳理相关文献与实践。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续金融理论、ESG评级与测量框架、风险管理理论、投资者行为理论
AI.method: 文献综述与实证研究相结合，分析ESG市场趋势数据
AI.findings: ESG资产增长迅速，基金流入持续上升；ESG评级存在不一致性；绿色债券和ESG基金等产品蓬勃发展；新兴市场的ESG实践尚需深入；国际监管框架正推动透明度与问责制。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统归纳了ESG投资领域的研究缺口（标准化、数据可靠性、新兴市场动态），为后续理论发展提供方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者、研究人员和政策制定者提供ESG如何提升长期财务表现、改善风险管理及促进可持续发展的实践指导。

title:
Volume Ignition to Base Ratio (Vibr)

A Contrarian Volume Indicator for Predicting Short-Term Equity Returns in Indian Markets
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title:
Volume Ignition to Base Ratio (Vibr)

A Contrarian Volume Indicator for Predicting Short-Term Equity Returns in Indian Markets

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest. No external funding was received for this research. All analysis was conducted independently using publicly available market data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All costs were borne independently by the author.

detail.abstract: This paper introduces the Volume Ignition to Base Ratio (VIBR), a novel technical indicator that quantifies the contrast between a stock's breakout week volume and its preceding 100-day average base volume for NSE-listed equities. Contrary to conventional technical analysis wisdom, which holds that high-volume breakouts predict superior forward returns, our analysis of 807 signals across 474 stocks from May 2023 to May 2026 demonstrates a statistically significant inverse relationship between VIBR magnitude and subsequent returns. Low-VIBR signals (below 2x) generate average 4-week returns of 20.20% with an 89.0% win rate, significantly outperforming high-VIBR ignition signals (above 5x) which generate 11.91% returns at a 67.0% win rate. A model portfolio simulation deploying Rs 10,00,000 per strategy over 3 years confirms these findings: the low-VIBR strategy compounds to Rs 59,55,498 (CAGR: 82.3%) versus Rs 39,35,375 (CAGR: 58.6%) for the high-VIBR strategy when a 12% stop loss is applied. Both primary findings are statistically significant at p < 0.0001. These results challenge O'Neil's CAN SLIM volume orthodoxy and suggest that quiet institutional accumulation without retail participation is a more reliable predictor of short-term returns than explosive volume breakouts. The VIBR indicator, its classification thresholds, and a replicable Chartink screener implementation are presented for further validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VIBR指标（成交量激增与基准比），发现低成交量突破信号（低于2倍）比高成交量突破信号（高于5倍）能带来显著更高的短期收益（4周回报20.20% vs 11.91%），挑战了传统技术分析中"放量突破预示上涨"的经典观点。
AI.research_question: 成交量激增程度（VIBR指标）与股票短期未来收益之间是否存在显著关系？高成交量突破是否真的预示着更好的短期回报？
AI.motivation: 挑战O'Neil CAN SLIM体系中"放量突破为强势信号"的传统技术分析共识，验证成交量激增与后续收益之间的真实关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: VIBR指标（Volume Ignition to Base Ratio）、CAN SLIM选股体系、成交量价格关系理论、机构积累vs零售参与理论。
AI.method: 对2023年5月至2026年5月NSE上市的474只股票中的807个信号进行实证分析，构建低VIBR（低于2倍）和高VIBR（高于5倍）策略组合，设置12%止损，进行3年模拟投资组合回测。
AI.findings: 低VIBR信号4周平均回报20.20%（胜率89.0%），高VIBR信号仅11.91%（胜率67.0%）；低VIBR策略3年复合至595.5万卢比（CAGR 82.3%），高VIBR策略仅393.5万卢比（CAGR 58.6%）；两者均在p<0.0001水平显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 对传统"放量突破预示上涨"理论提出实证挑战，揭示"安静的机构积累"比"放量激增"更能预测短期收益，补充了成交量与价格关系的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可复制的VIBR指标及其分类阈值，给出Chartink筛选器实现方案，为量化交易者和技术分析投资者提供可操作的选股工具。

title: Development of Artificial Intelligence and Potential Impact of Its Applications in Agriculture on Labor Use and Productivity
affiliations: National Research Institute (PIB) - Institute of Agricultural and Food Economics - National Research Institute (IAFE-NRI)

detail.title: Development of Artificial Intelligence and Potential Impact of Its Applications in Agriculture on Labor Use and Productivity
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (ai) is one of the most striking recent technology developments. potentially, it can significantly affect all areas of economic activities including agriculture. The paper addresses two issues such as the actual essence of ai and its most important current and expected future applications in agriculture and their potential impact on labor use and productivity of this sector. The research methods applied in the paper are critical analysis of selected literature sources and deductive reasoning regarding the likely influence of ai applications on labor use in agriculture and its total factor productivity. it was found out that applications of ai in agriculture are numerous and very diverse both in terms of technological solutions and managed processes. Moreover, the market for ai applications in agriculture is expected to grow quite rapidly due to an increasing tendency to automatize agricultural production and marketing processes. This inevitably leads to substitution of physical labor with sophisticated machinery and robots. also, it generates demand for new labor competencies needed to manage increasingly capital intensive agricultural production and related processes driven by the use of ai. Based on mainly theoretical considerations, it can be surmised that widespread use of ai in agriculture should positively contribute to the growth in the total factor productivity (TFp) of the sector. consequently, countries where agricultural producers adopt ai solutions faster can gain competitive advantage in food production.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了人工智能（AI）在农业中的本质、当前及未来应用，以及对劳动力使用和全要素生产率（TFP）的影响。研究发现AI在农业中的应用多样且广泛，能替代体力劳动并催生新技能需求，有望提升农业TFP，且快速采用AI的国家可获竞争优势。
AI.research_question: AI的本质是什么？AI在农业中的当前及预期应用有哪些？这些应用对农业劳动力使用和全要素生产率有何潜在影响？
AI.motivation: AI是近年最引人注目的技术发展之一，可能显著影响包括农业在内的所有经济活动领域，因此有必要系统分析其在农业中的应用及影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于技术变革对劳动力替代与技能需求的理论、全要素生产率理论。
AI.method: 对选定文献进行批判性分析，并采用演绎推理方法推断AI应用对农业劳动力使用和全要素生产率的影响。
AI.findings: （1）AI在农业中的应用在技术方案和管理流程上均极为多样；（2）AI农业应用市场将快速增长，推动生产与营销过程自动化；（3）AI替代体力劳动，同时催生新的劳动力技能需求；（4）广泛使用AI有望正向促进农业全要素生产率增长；（5）快速采用AI的国家可在粮食生产中获竞争优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 从理论层面系统阐释了AI对农业劳动力替代效应与技能升级效应的并存机制，并基于演绎推理提出AI应用与农业全要素生产率之间的正向关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为农业政策制定者和生产者提供了AI应用的现状与前景分析，指出了加速采用AI技术以获得竞争优势的战略方向。

title: From Awareness to Participation: The Role of Consumer Understanding in Vehicle-to-Grid Benefit Expectations
affiliations: The University of Sydney, New York University Abu Dhabi and The University of Sydney

detail.title: From Awareness to Participation: The Role of Consumer Understanding in Vehicle-to-Grid Benefit Expectations
detail.abstract: Vehicle-to-grid (V2G) has been widely promoted as a mechanism for integrating electric vehicles (EVs) into electricity markets by enabling bidirectional energy flows. While much of the existing literature focuses on technical feasibility and system-level value, comparatively less attention has been paid to how EV owners perceive the private financial benefits associated with participation. This study examines how awareness and conceptual understanding of V2G shape expected annual electricity bill savings among EV owners. Using data from a nationwide survey of Australian 1,794 EV owners, we distinguish between awareness of V2G and correct conceptualisation of the technology. We estimate a sample-selection endogenous ordered probit model that jointly accounts for non-random awareness and endogeneity in correct understanding when modelling perceived savings. Results indicate that awareness and understanding are distinct phenomena and that correct conceptualisation is strongly associated with higher expected financial benefits. Predicted mean perceived annual savings approximately double when respondents correctly define V2G. At the same time, overall expectations remain modest, with most EV owners anticipating incremental rather than substantial bill reductions. Significant heterogeneity emerges across segments, particularly by solar panel ownership, battery storage ownership, home charging access, and age. The findings suggest that informational frictions and incomplete understanding may act as behavioural constraints on V2G participation, even in a context characterised by high residential solar uptake and widespread home charging. From a policy perspective, the results underscore the importance of clear communication, contract transparency, and targeted program design in scaling V2G participation. Integrating behavioural insight into energy-transport policy may therefore be critical to realising the flexibility potential of electrified mobility.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于澳大利亚1,794名电动汽车车主的全国调查数据，区分了车主对V2G技术的"知晓"与"正确理解"两个概念，发现正确理解V2G能使预期电费节约翻倍，但整体预期仍较保守，且存在显著的异质性。
AI.research_question: 电动汽车车主对V2G的知晓和正确理解如何影响其预期的年度电费节约？
AI.motivation: 现有V2G文献多关注技术可行性和系统价值，较少关注车主对参与V2G所获个人财务收益的感知，而车主的主观认知可能是影响V2G推广的行为约束。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息摩擦理论、行为经济学（有限理性与认知偏差）、技术采纳模型
AI.method: 采用样本选择内生有序Probit模型，联合处理非随机知晓和正确理解中的内生性问题；基于澳大利亚1,794名EV车主的全国调查数据。
AI.findings: (1)知晓与正确理解是两个不同的现象；(2)正确理解V2G与更高预期财务收益显著相关，预期节约近翻倍；(3)总体预期仍较保守，多数车主预期边际节约；(4)存在显著的异质性，尤其按太阳能板、电池储能、家庭充电接入和年龄划分。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了"知晓"与"正确理解"两个认知维度，揭示了信息摩擦和认知不完全是V2G参与的行为约束，丰富了技术采纳与行为经济学交叉领域的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了精准建议：需加强清晰沟通、合约透明度和针对性项目设计，将行为洞察融入能源-交通政策以释放V2G灵活性潜力。

title: After Oil: Electric Vehicle Adoption, Prices, and Consumer Welfare in Britain

detail.title: After Oil: Electric Vehicle Adoption, Prices, and Consumer Welfare in Britain
detail.abstract: I estimate how transport taxes affect vehicle use, fleet composition, and welfare in Britain. The intensive-margin design exploits quasi-random variation in MOT test dates, which generates differences in fuel-cost exposure across vehicle test intervals. I combine these estimates with a multinomial logit model of local fuel-type shares to simulate carbon and road-tax counterfactuals. The results show that carbon taxation affects both miles driven and fleet composition, but much of the extensive-margin adjustment occurs within the fossil-fuel fleet, especially from diesel toward petrol, with smaller spillovers to electric vehicles, consistent with persistent preference frictions that limit the speed of EV adoption.

AI.tldr: 本文估计了英国交通税对车辆使用、车队构成和福利的影响。研究发现碳税同时影响行驶里程和车队构成，但车队调整主要发生在化石燃料车辆内部（尤其是从柴油转向汽油），向电动汽车的溢出效应较小，这反映了限制电动汽车采用速度的持续性偏好摩擦。
AI.research_question: 交通税如何影响车辆使用、车队构成及社会福利？
AI.motivation: 理解碳税和道路税在减少交通碳排放方面的实际效果，特别是消费者对税收政策的响应机制（集约边际与广延边际）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于消费者行为理论，结合集约边际（行驶里程）和广延边际（车队构成）调整，利用MOT测试日期的准随机变化识别燃料成本冲击，并采用多项逻辑模型模拟地方燃料类型份额。
AI.method: 准实验设计（MOT测试日期为准随机变化）+ 多项逻辑模型（Multinomial Logit）模拟地方燃料类型份额，进行反事实模拟。
AI.findings: 碳税同时影响行驶里程和车队构成；车队调整主要发生在化石燃料内部（柴油转向汽油），向电动汽车的溢出较小，表明存在持续性偏好摩擦限制电动汽车普及速度。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了碳税的广延边际调整主要发生在化石燃料内部而非向电动化转型，为偏好摩擦理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为交通碳税和道路税政策设计提供实证依据，表明仅靠碳税难以快速推动电动化转型，需要辅以其他政策克服消费者偏好摩擦。

title: Interim License Declarations, Arbitration Offers and the FRAND Balance in SEP Disputes
affiliations: Ericsson

detail.title: Interim License Declarations, Arbitration Offers and the FRAND Balance in SEP Disputes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is employed by Ericsson, which operates in the sector addressed in this paper. No separate remuneration or compensation was received for the research, writing, or publication of this work.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the growing use of interim license declarations in UK SEP litigation through the lens of the FRAND balance embedded in the ETSI IPR Policy. It argues that, because declaratory relief under UK law must serve a legitimate and useful purpose, courts should assess whether such declarations preserve the balance between preventing SEP owner holdup and implementer hold-out.
